data.name: Nature Minds
data.detailed_description:
THE AWAKENING – TAREQ AND THE BRACELET OF DILMUN

You play as Tareq, a young warrior drawn into this turmoil when the ancient Bracelet of Dilmun binds itself to him. The bracelet contains four fragmented spirits, each vital to restoring the world’s balance. To complete the artifact and uncover the truth behind Gilgamesh’s immortality, Tareq must reclaim their essence by facing their corrupted forms across distant and dangerous lands.

GILGARDIA – THE CITY OF THE IMMORTAL KING

Long ago, the desert city of Gilgardia rose under the reign of Gilgamesh, a ruler whose discovery of the legendary Plant of Immortality granted him eternal life. His ambition expanded beyond human limits, and in his pursuit of total dominion over nature, he shattered the ancient harmony that once protected the world. With the spirits corrupted and forgotten realms awakening, balance collapsed and chaos began its slow rise.

OASIS OF WISDOM – THE REALM OF HOOBOKS

Your journey leads first into the tranquil yet mysterious Oasis of Wisdom, home of Hooboks, the hoopoe spirit of illusion and navigation. Her oasis is not what it seems—calm waters reflect deceptive realities, shifting paths emerge between palms, and mirage doubles test your senses. To find her true form within this living riddle, Tareq must see through illusion and uncover the hidden truths buried within the oasis.

KINGDOM OF WAVES – MUJAN’S OCEAN THRONE

Beneath the endless blue horizon lies the Kingdom of Waves, ruled by Mujan, the colossal blue whale whose tides once nourished life. His massive body and sweeping fins command the ocean itself, creating crushing currents and spiraling whirlpools. Ancient ruins, coral palaces, and collapsing domes form a treacherous underwater battlefield where Tareq must adapt to shifting gravity and overwhelming pressure to purify the spirit of the ocean.

SAMAYA – THE CITY IN THE SKY

High above the world floats Samaya, the city in the sky ruled by Nassran, the powerful falcon spirit with silver-grey feathers. Once a guardian of freedom and wind, he now wields a wind-forged bow and summons storms capable of tearing through stone. The floating islands of Samaya shift and rotate with every gust, transforming the skies into a battlefield where mastery of movement becomes essential for survival.

NIGHTINGALE FOREST – GOLDEN’S RADIANT DOMAIN

Deep within the lush and enchanted Nightingale Forest lives Golden, the mighty gorilla infused with radiant sunlight. His celestial spear glows with scorching brilliance, lighting the forest in dazzling beams that ignite paths and awaken ancient roots. Nature itself bends around his overwhelming presence, reshaping the forest into a living arena that responds to every strike of his radiant power.

THE QUEST FOR BALANCE – COMPLETING THE BRACELET OF DILMUN

Reclaiming each spirit strengthens the Bracelet of Dilmun, unlocking new powers tied to wind, illusion, ocean, and sunlight. Only by gathering all four spirits can Tareq restore the relic’s full potential and reveal the truth behind Gilgamesh’s immortal transformation. The road to balance leads back to Gilgardia, where the heart of destiny awaits.

COMPANIONS OF DESTINY – THE ALLIES OF THE JOURNEY

Tareq’s path is shaped by the allies he meets. Ribah, a desert tracker with unmatched perception; Elyas, a scholar unlocking long-buried truths; Lina, an archer guided by ancient vows; Hakeem, a former Gilgardian guard torn between justice and loyalty. Their stories intertwine with Tareq’s, offering strength, insight, and choices that influence the world around you.

A LIVING WORLD – SHAPED BY SPIRITS AND TIME

Your adventure takes you through drifting sky cities glowing in morning light, sunken temples echoing beneath roaring oceans, enchanted oases filled with illusion magic, radiant jungles alive with spirit energy, and ruins of vanished empires swallowed by shifting sands. Weather, time, and the moods of the spirits reshape each region, ensuring every journey feels alive and unpredictable.

THE MOUNTS OF LEGEND – THE THREE ARABIAN IMPOSSIBLE LEGENDS

Nature itself becomes your companion. Throughout your journey, you will ride mythical mounts shaped by the spirits, from desert beasts to sky creatures. At the heart of these legends lie the Three Impossible Legends in Arabic Culture: the Ghoul, the Phoenix—a bird of flame whose rebirth defies death, and the Loyal friend. It is from these impossibilities that the Phoenix awakens once more. As Tareq proves himself worthy, this legendary creature becomes his mount, carrying him across deserts, jungles, oceans, and the skies of Samaya. Every mount grows stronger as your bond deepens.

THE FATE OF DILMUN – A WORLD ON THE EDGE

Every land holds secrets. Every spirit carries memories of a time before imbalance. Every battle pushes Tareq closer to understanding the fragile harmony that binds nature and life.

To restore balance, he must confront the immortal king.
To change the world, he must first understand it.
To save Dilmun… he must face what began it all.

data.short_description: Nature Minds is an action-adventure RPG where you explore ancient realms, battle spirit guardians, ride a legendary Phoenix, and uncover the hidden powers within the Bracelet of Dilmun.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
